dialog: I'll crush you in no time flat!
I'll beat you all up/ and that'll be that!
Hahaha! I'm gonna blow you all up!
You're gonna regret picking a fight with me!
Let's make this a flashy one!
Teehee/ you're gonna be my next plaything!
Let's see how tough you are!
You can all just go away!
Just gonna take a break here.
Coming on a little strong/ don't you think?
You... I'm gonna tear you to pieces!
To the victor go the spoils!
I'll swoop in like whoosh!\n　And beat them like BAM!
Hey/ I'm gonna blow them up now!
Y'know/ I'm not really built for this...
Last one in's a rotten egg!
Hope it's fine if I blow them up!
Being stuck behind you is booooring!
Playing with me's pretty fun/ right?
Let's go/ let's go! I can hardly contain myself!
I've never had so much fun in my whole life!
Let's beat the absolute crud outta them!
Marisa! Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
Don't worry Marisa/ I got it!
I'll give what's left of you to Marisa!
Hey Marisa/ can I take the lead this time?
Marisa/ let's play with that one!
I wanna see your magic Marisa!
C'mon Marisa/ give me a turn!
C'mon Marisa/ let's go all out!
Hey Marisa/ check out MY magic!
I can be pretty flashy too/ Marisa!
She took the shot for me...\n　Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
I'll handle it/ so just keep your nose in your books.
For someone who lugs around books all day/ you're not very strong/ huh?
Patchouli'd be real annoyed if you broke on my watch.
Put down the books and maybe you'd dodge better.
If you're playing with me/ then we gotta play bullet tag!
Hey devil lady/ think you can keep up?
Meiling! Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
Don't worry Meiling/ I got it!
Even Meiling gets hurt sometimes/ so I'll cover her!
Hey Meiling/ can I take the lead this time?
I'll give what's left of you to Meiling!
Meiling/ let's play with that one!
C'mon Meiling/ I can hardly wait!
Let's take them down together/ Meiling!
Patchouli! Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
Now that Patchouli's done/ check out MY magic!
Don't worry Patchouli/ I got it!
Oh come on Patchouli! Move those feet!
What/ were you too busy reading to dodge?
Hey Patchouli. You want me to get this one/ right?
Bullet tag's fun and all/ but Patchouli's always so...\n　leisurely about it.
C'mon Patchouli/ let's go all out!
Let's play with them together/ Patchouli!
Hey Patchouli/ check out MY magic!
Sakuya! Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
Sakuya with the pass/ and Flandre gets the goal!
Don't worry Sakuya/ I got it!
I guess even Sakuya spaces out sometimes...
You can clean up after I'm done/ Sakuya!
Sakuya/ you follow me this time/ okay?
Sakuya/ lemme blow this one up!
C'mon Sakuya/ I can hardly wait!
Hey Sakuya/ check out MY magic!
Hey Sakuya/ it's okay if we break these ones/ right?
Remi! Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
Teehee/ I never thought Remi and I would be playing together...
If you're done with this blood bag/ can I have it?
Don't worry Remi/ I got it.
I won't let you hurt Remi!
Hey Remi/ can I come out to play?
Teehee/ Remi and I are gonna have so much fun with you!
Remi/ lemme blow this one up!
My sister and I'll deal with you together!
C'mon Remi/ I can hardly wait!
Hey Remi/ check out MY magic!
Koishi! Don't worry/ I'll blow them up for you!
Gosh/ you're even more of a handful than I am...
Ok Koishi/ we're going for this one/ okay?\n　This one right here!
That's the one right there/ Koishi!
I wanna see your danmaku too/ Koishi!
C'mon Koishi/ I can hardly wait!
Alright Koishi/ let's play our hearts out!
Hey Koishi/ check out my magic!
Hey! You scuffed up my clothes...
You look like you're not having fun.
Geez/ why do they always stick me with the small fry?
I can't take much more of this!
Don't tell me/ you're just toying with me?!
Gah! Just get it over with already!
No way/ am I gonna lose?!
Oh no/ what do I now?!
Ouch! I gotta pick up the pace!
You're a real eyesore/ you know that?!
If you think that's enough/ you're dead wrong.
I've still got plenty of blood in the tank!
Ow! The heck was that about?!
Wait/ were you actually trying to hit me?
Not gonna hit me with that one!
Teehee/ you gotta try harder than that!
I have a play toy over here...
Oh my god/ you are soooo slow!\n　So I'm just gonna come to you first!
Remi'll get even for me! You'll see!
I haven't had enough fun yet/ but... I shouldn't push myself/ right?
Remi'll take care of the rest. I'm sure of it!
I can keep going/ but... I shouldn't push myself/ right?
I don't gotta know who you are to beat you up!
You're not gonna stop our vacation!
I'll destroy the power of that evil god!
I gotta be careful/ I don't wanna hurt Utsuho.
You girls are probably worth playing with!
I've never been to Heaven before...
Do you guys get the sun in Heaven?\n　I'm not really into that...
Proud of your toughness? I'll crack you wide open!
Doesn't matter how tough they are/ a peach's a peach.
I don't really give a crap what your deal is/ sheepy.
You're a bad guy/ so I can go all out on you!
You're not taking this super seriously/ huh?
Guess you're not gonna go all out yet/ are you?
This ought to clear your head!
Take a good look at my danmaku!
You're a bad guy/ so I can go all out on you!
I've got practice blowing up doppelgangers!
You guys don't match up to real deals at all.
A second Remi... Nah/ one's plenty.
Kind of a different vibe from when clone myself...
You can't just go around breaking whatever you want...
Now we can seriously beat the stuffing out of each other!
I've always wanted to go all out with you!
I'm not going easy on you/ sheepy!
Just get out of our way!
She seems way more dangerous now...
If I'm not careful she might really break...
Come on/ you really shouldn't be fighting anymore!
Teehee! The final boss/ at long last!
I'll destroy you/ AND your dream!
You don't understand the power of kindness.\n　Not one bit!
Teehee! The final/ FINAL boss! Finally!
I'll destroy you/ AND your dream!
You're even worse than Makura. You don't even know what kindness is!
I can't let Marisa beat me!
This is WAY funner than playing by myself!
I can't let Marisa beat me!
This is WAY funner than playing by myself!
Come a little closer. I dare you...
Did I get stung by a bug just now?
Gotta clean up all my toys...
Maaan... I wish Marisa were here...
Gotta clean up all my toys...
Time to put these toys in their place!
Maaan... I wish Marisa were here...
Come a little closer. I dare you...
Did I get stung by a bug just now?
Whoops! I was looking somewhere else...
I haven't had enough fun yet/ but... I shouldn't push myself/ right?
